What we set up

Every event gets gear picked and placed for the room it's actually in — not a one-size-fits-all rig.

Dance lighting

Moving heads and beam effects that keep the dance floor moving from first song to last.

Ambient lighting

Soft wash and fill light that sets the mood without competing with décor or photos.

Stage lighting

Front and back light for speeches, performances, and anything that needs to read clearly on camera.

Uplighting

Wall and pillar washes that change the whole feel of a venue in a single colour choice.

UV lighting

Blacklight setups for themed parties, glow effects, and after-dark energy.

Who we are

Luminex Lighting is a Windhoek-based event lighting rental company, built for hosts who want a production-quality look without a production-company price tag.

  • Modern, well-maintained lighting gear
  • An eye for aesthetics as much as technical setup
  • Fair pricing, built for small and mid-sized events
  • Fast, responsive communication before and during your event
